Windows Runtime metadata (.winmd), vendored for NovaOS
======================================================

Source: https://github.com/microsoft/windows-rs (MIT OR Apache-2.0; NovaOS
takes it under MIT, LICENSE), commit 9568d7a621539f02b965e1cbfb811bc9c45d5f6f.
Kept, unchanged:
  crates/libs/default/Windows.winmd          Windows' own types (the
      Windows SDK's Windows.* namespaces: Foundation, UI.Composition,
      ApplicationModel.Core, UI.Core, ...)
  crates/tools/reactor-metadata/winmd/       the Windows App SDK's
      Microsoft.UI.winmd                     "lifted" Composition, Input,
      Microsoft.UI.Text.winmd                Content, Dispatching and
      Microsoft.Graphics.winmd               Windowing types XAML's IDL
      Microsoft.Foundation.winmd             names, DirectX enums, MRT Core
      Microsoft.Windows.ApplicationModel.Resources.winmd
      Microsoft.UI.Xaml.winmd                the published XAML types: read
                                             only for their IIDs

tools/winrt/abigen.py reads them, with the XAML framework's IDL
(third_party/microsoft-ui-xaml), and writes the C++ ABI headers MIDL and
the Windows SDK would give (docs/design/windows-ui-xaml.md).  The build
generates them into its include directory for the programs and DLLs whose
manifest says "winrt_abi": true.

To update: copy the same files from a newer windows-rs commit and rebuild;
abigen.py's check (python3 tools/winrt/abigen.py --check) compares the
XAML IDL against Microsoft.UI.Xaml.winmd.
